title: Align to Cell (Tables)

scenarios.title: Align to Cell applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Align to Cell (BtnAlignToTableCell) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnAlignToTableCell deterministic Office leg (align probe to cell bottom-right)

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the layout context-menu alignment entry BOTTOM_RIGHT on a fixture 3x3 table (40/40, 100x50 cells) with a 40x20 probe rectangle selected - its center inside cell (2,2) - moves the probe to Left 200 / Top 120 (the cell's bottom-right corner minus the probe size), keeps the probe's dimensions, leaves the table fully untouched (3x3, 100/50 cells, 300x150 at 40/40, texts intact), reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the layout context-menu alignment entry BOTTOM_RIGHT on a fixture 3x3 table (40/40, 100x50 cells) with a 40x20 probe rectangle selected - its center inside cell (2,2) - moves the probe to Left 200 / Top 120 (the cell's bottom-right corner minus the probe size), keeps the probe's dimensions, leaves the table fully untouched (3x3, 100/50 cells, 300x150 at 40/40, texts intact), reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
